subStrands.name: Hospitality Industry, Establishments, Safety and Hygiene

objectives.description: Hospitality industry/catering: definitions of hospitality and catering; components of hospitality industry.
Types of catering establishments e.g. hotel, restaurant, hospitality catering, outdoor catering, school, mobile catering etc.; functions of catering establishments.
Culinary terms: culinary terms commonly used in catering; glossary of culinary terms.
Safety precaution in catering: types and causes of accidents; prevention/management; first aid; fire fighting equipment.
Sanitation and hygiene in catering: water sanitation, environmental sanitation, food safety practices, kitchen hygiene, personal hygiene.

strands.name: Food Commodities and Methods of Preparation

objectives.description: Study of food commodities: poultry, game, meat, fish, vegetables, fruits, dairy products, pulses, cereals, herbs, flavourings etc.
Methods of cooking: boiling e.g. stock, soups and sauces; roasting e.g. fish, beef and poultry; grilling e.g. fish, meat etc.; baking e.g. pastry and confectionery.
Principles of cooking methods; preparation of the various food commodities; standard/local measurements.

subStrands.name: Food Service Personnel, Types of Service, Drinks and Costing

objectives.description: Food and beverage service personnel: personnel in the foods and beverage area; functions of food and beverage personnel.

Types of food service and table laying/setting: different types of food service e.g. Gueridon, silver service, waiter service, vending, buffet and banquet service; types of covers; types of table laying/setting.
Types of alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks: bar, alcoholic beverages, non-alcoholic beverages.
Costing and control in catering: cost/sales, dish costing, portion control.
Types of kitchen equipment and their uses.
Care and maintenance of kitchen equipment: care and maintenance of various kitchen equipment.

subStrands.name: Principles, Types, Special Menus and Accompaniments

objectives.description: Principles of menu planning: meaning and scope of menu; factors that affect menu planning.
Types of menu: table d'hote, a la carte and special occasions; others — breakfast, tea, dinner, supper, luncheon, carte du jour, plate du jour etc.
Special menu and demonstrations: meals plan for vegetarians; meals plan for the vulnerable group; meals plan for manual and sedentary workers etc.
